meta.name: review-work
meta.description: Post-implementation gate review: run manual QA on the real surface yourself, then launch ONE gate reviewer (never a panel) to audit goal, constraints, code quality, security, missed context, and QA evidence. Use before a PR handoff or when the user explicitly asks to review completed work.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 交付代码前先自己跑一遍人工验收,再让一名审查者逐项把关目标、约束、质量与安全
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果每次提 PR 前都担心漏掉验收步骤或质量问题
copy.tagline_en: Run your own manual QA, then one focused gate review before the PR handoff
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want a consistent quality gate before every PR handoff.

howto.what: 它会先自己在真实界面上做手工 QA(保留命令和产出记录),再只派一个 gate reviewer 子代理审查目标、约束、代码质量、安全、遗漏上下文和 QA 证据;QA 矩阵没有失败行、且审查者返回 APPROVE 才算通过。
howto.when: 在把工作交接成 PR 之前,或你明确要求审查已完成的工作时触发。它只针对已完成的实现做事后审查。

say.text: 帮我审查一下刚完成的改动
say.note: 先做手工 QA,再派一个 gate reviewer

say.text: PR 交接前先跑一次 gate review
say.note: QA 有失败行会直接报 REVIEW FAILED

say.text: 针对这个分支做审查,基准是 main
say.note: 按分支点收集 diff 和改动文件

howto.what_en: It first runs manual QA on the real surface, then launches ONE gate reviewer sub-agent to audit goal, constraints, code quality, security, missed context and QA evidence. It passes only if no QA row fails and the reviewer approves.
howto.when_en: Triggers before a PR handoff, or when you explicitly ask to review completed work. It is a post-implementation gate review.

say_en.text: Review the change I just finished
say_en.note: Runs manual QA first, then one gate reviewer

say_en.text: Run a gate review before the PR handoff
say_en.note: A failing QA row reports REVIEW FAILED
Collects diff and changed files from the branch point
